issue_title: Address payload serialization drops account-vs-contract variant information
operational_risk: Bridges, off-chain indexers, or OApps may misinterpret address kind and produce brittle integrations.
recommended_mitigation: Encode the address discriminant/tag together with bytes.
Document any intentional cross-chain canonical address format and add round-trip tests for account and contract addresses.
root_cause: Cross-runtime address serialization discards type metadata needed to faithfully reconstruct the original address domain.
source_name: Code4rena 2026-04 LayerZero Stellar Endpoint final report
source_report_section: Non-critical / informational findings: write_address_payload loses account/contract address variant tag
summary: An address codec can serialize address bytes without preserving whether the original Soroban address was an account or contract variant. The public report treated this as compatibility/integration risk unless a downstream consumer relies on the lost tag for authorization or routing.
when_it_could_escalate: A receiver authorizes contract addresses and account addresses differently but consumes the tagless payload.
A routed message or refund can be redirected because two address domains collide after serialization.
why_not_medium_or_high: Tag loss alone is not enough for Medium/High unless the receiving side makes a security decision based on reconstructed address kind or can be tricked into routing/authorizing value incorrectly.
